name: wds_sun397_official_splits
description: wds_sun397_official_splits provides WebDataset-formatted official train/validation/test splits for the SUN397 scene recognition dataset (397 scene categories). It is intended to evaluate image classification models on large-scale scene recognition across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. The splits facilitate reproducible training and benchmarking at scale using streaming/webdataset pipelines.
reputation: SUN397 is a well-known and widely used scene-recognition benchmark in the computer vision community; these official webdataset splits are used for scalable training and reproducible evaluation.
